result.edit: The failure occurs at cycle 11 when checking a group of 000000. The state machine incorrectly transitions from sf4 directly to sf6 regardless of the data input, causing an incorrect not_match output. The fix makes sf4 properly check the data input to determine whether to transition to sf5 (for data=1) or sf6 (for data=0), preserving the sequence detection logic. This matches the specification where each bit in the group should be checked before determining the final output.
